rationale: The original thesis just confirmed mechanically — price broke the $12.61 low and is printing new session lows with volume re-expanding on the break (2.8k → 9.3k on the push to $12.48), still below both VWAP ($13.21) and the 9-EMA, with a risk-off tape (SPY -0.77%, VIXY +2.66%) and zero reversal signature or new headlines. The $12.30 target is only ~1.4% away (under one 5m ATR), so banking the trade now forfeits the payoff of a working breakdown, and a flip to long would require a reclaim of the broken $12.61 level or a capitulation signature that is not present.
